name: Awakened Rot Grub Swarm
tactics: The motion of an awakened swarm has a strange symmetry, as if each grub were moving in perfect formation with the rest. The swarm’s telepathy manifests as a constant chatter of moans and simple phrases in Deep Speech, such as “All must join, all must find sanctuary,” and “Without us, within them, reap their flesh.” The psyches of those devoured by a swarm sometimes crop up among these thoughts as well.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

resistances.name: Melee and Ranged
resistances.details: Half damage from melee and ranged attacks

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Swarm Attack
traits.details: Any enemy that starts its turn within the aura takes 10 damage plus 2 extra damage for each additional rot grub swarm adjacent to the enemy.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.details: The awakened rot grub swarm can occupy the same space as another creature, and an enemy can enter its space, which is difficult terrain. The awakened rot grub swarm cannot be pulled, pushed, or slid by melee or ranged attacks. It can squeeze through any opening that is large enough for at least one of the creatures it comprises.

traits.name: Clumsy Attacker
traits.details: The awakened rot grub swarm lacks a melee basic attack.

auras.name: Swarm Attack
auras.details: Any enemy that starts its turn within the aura takes 10 damage plus 2 extra damage for each additional rot grub swarm adjacent to the enemy.

hit.description: The target is immobilized until the end of the awakened swarm’s next turn.
The swarm pulls the target 4 squares.
